decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the three contiguous Ector County parcels whose owner of record is Texas Critical Data Centers LLC (TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels, Ector Appraisal District, tax year 2026): 47010.00020.00000 (a preemption-survey 235 acre tract), 46960.00010.00000 (a preemption-survey tract, 80 acres) and 42030.00040.00000 (T-2-S Blk 41 Sec 31, Card #4, S part, 54.456 acres), as the campus locator for the Texas Critical Data Centers (TCDC) landholding of New Era Energy & Digital. The union is one polygon of 403.922 geodesic acres and its centroid lies inside it. It locates the TCDC landholding, not a Phase 1 building, footprint or construction extent; the parcel service carries two account records for 46960.00010.00000 with identical geometry and legal description but legal areas of 80 and 205.13 acres, so the legal acreage under the company name is 369.456 or 494.586 acres depending on which record is current, against the company's stated 493 acres; no land beyond the mapped polygons is asserted.
